Obsidian's own interface follows the Tema you choose (System/Light/Dark).

Some mods that restyle system elements — Notification Style, Toast Style, and Dialog Style — are designed and tested for dark mode only. When the Android system is in light mode they switch off automatically, leaving the stock OOS light appearance instead of forcing a dark-only style onto it.

All other mods (icons, navigation, Always-On Display, etc.) are unaffected and keep working regardless of the system theme.

For the best experience, keep your device's system theme set to dark.
